_note: Episode 7 keyframes (same method as Episodes 2-6). Indio has NO medallion in every frame. Real people: Rizal is never shown (only a far grave mound); Narcisa and the 1898 group only from behind and far away, inside the lens circle. No body, no blood, no weapons. The lens is always a round golden-edged view. Memory shots of the Lolo are warm sepia. plates/field.jpg, full/intro.jpg and full/tattoo.jpg are copies from Episode 6 (tattoo shows five tattoos, still correct: no new one).

plates.paco_wall: the outside foot of a tall old weathered circular stone cemetery wall in Manila in 1896, rows of small arched niches in the wall, tall grass and loose earth at its base, a few bare trees, overcast pale morning light, quiet and lonely.
plates.lolo_room: a small old Filipino house room at night, wooden walls, a capiz shell window, a low wooden bed with a thin blanket, a kerosene lamp glowing warm, soft sepia memory haze.

full.phone_low: extreme close-up of a brown hand holding a smartphone in misty morning light, the screen showing only a red almost-empty battery icon and a crossed-out signal icon, old stone walls blurred behind.
full.phone_photo: extreme close-up of a smartphone screen in a brown hand, showing one blurred photo thumbnail of an old yellowed handwritten letter, a small unread dot beside it, soft glow.
full.box_lining: close-up of an old empty wooden keepsake box with a round hollow inside, its faded red cloth lining lifted at one corner by an old woman's wrinkled fingers, a folded yellowed letter hidden underneath, warm lamp light.
full.cart_far: seen from far behind on a misty dirt road at dawn in 1896, a closed dark horse-drawn carriage moving away, a few uniformed guards walking beside it, old stone walls and bare trees, solemn.
full.paco_far: seen from far away across tall grass, an old circular stone cemetery wall with an open iron gate, inside a small mound of freshly turned earth with no marker, two uniformed guards standing far off, grey morning, solemn, no other people.
full.letter: extreme close-up of a smartphone screen showing a photo of an old yellowed letter written in elegant faded ink, only illegible scribbled lines, the phone held in a brown hand, dim light.
full.lolo_arm: close-up of an old man's wrinkled brown forearm resting on a wooden table, five separate small indigo geometric tattoo marks spaced in a straight line from wrist to elbow, warm sepia memory light, no face in frame.
full.lolo_m: warm sepia memory scene, seen from behind, a man in a loose white collarless shirt facing a young woman in a long dark coat holding a red umbrella, misty field at dawn, she holds out an open hand, faces not visible.
full.lolo_run: warm sepia memory scene, a man in a loose white collarless shirt seen from behind running away into a swirl of golden light on a misty field, a red umbrella small and far behind him.
full.lolo_bury: warm sepia memory scene, close-up of two hands placing a small bundle wrapped in brown cloth into a hole at the foot of an old stone wall, loose earth, grass, no face in frame.
full.lens: close-up of a brown hand holding an old round glass lens with a worn golden rim, crumbs of dark earth on it, a glint of light across the glass, old stone wall blurred behind.
full.lens_view: view through a round golden-rimmed lens filling the frame: inside the circle only an empty old circular stone cemetery wall and grass under clouds streaking fast across the sky, no people, no faces, outside the circle dark and blurred.
full.narcisa_far: view through a round golden-rimmed lens: inside the circle, far away and seen from behind, a slim woman in a long dark 1890s Filipino skirt and a dark veil walking along old cemetery walls, looking at the ground, outside the circle dark.
full.rpj: view through a round golden-rimmed lens: inside the circle, a small plain white marble slab lying on a mound of fresh earth, three small carved marks on it, wild grass, soft grey light, outside the circle dark.
full.lens_1898: view through a round golden-rimmed lens: inside the circle, far away and seen from behind, a small group of people in 1890s clothes standing quietly by the cemetery wall in bright morning light, white flowers, outside the circle dark.
full.park_today: a round walled garden park in Manila today, an old circular stone wall with arched niches around a wide green lawn, neat paths, a few visitors far away, modern city towers behind, bright afternoon, no cross, no church, no religious statue.
full.memory_lolo: warm sepia memory scene at night, an old grandfather sitting on a low bed holding a glowing bronze medallion up near his face with both hands, a small boy with empty hands half hidden behind the wooden door frame, watching, kerosene lamp light, soft haze.
full.medallion_answer: close-up of old wrinkled hands cupping an old round bronze medallion engraved with a sun and a triangle, a soft golden light rising from it like a breath, dark room, sepia haze.
full.datus: dreamy storybook painting: twelve round bronze medallions floating in a dark cave in a circle, each glowing faintly with the small sleeping figure of a warrior curled inside, and one bright star high above them.
full.shoes: close-up of a pair of old black leather shoes lying on bare earth, a small scrap of yellowed paper crumbling to dust beside them, soft grey light, quiet.
full.phone_dying: extreme close-up of a smartphone screen in a brown hand at dusk, a photo of an old handwritten letter with illegible lines, a thin red battery bar at the top, the screen starting to dim.
full.tala: one bright golden star shining alone in a deep blue dusk sky above the dark top of an old stone wall, faint rays of light, quiet.
full.phone_black: a brown hand holding a smartphone with a completely black dead screen, the glass reflecting a few stars of the dusk sky, old stone wall blurred behind.
full.walk_away: seen from behind, a young man in a loose white shirt with a red headband and a black dog with a red kerchief walking side by side down a long dirt road toward a small town of nipa houses at sunset, long shadows.
full.sit_wait: seen from behind, a young man in a loose white shirt with a red headband and a black dog with a red kerchief sitting side by side on a low stone wall, watching a wide orange sunset over fields and palm trees.
